scope: Optional generic SKY130 metal fill in normal Finish; independent five-layer database/GDS geometry checks; fill-bearing macro abstracts and bound export evidence. Four fresh application runs, full public windows on one 840 um reference, strict reference LVS and native custom NMOS/PMOS controls. No Tiny Tapeout interface or tile restriction. Complete profile applicability and foundry signoff remain open.

remaining: Account for every applicable requirement in the approved block/transistor profile. The historical 302 catalog records are not waived or relabeled; applicability needs independent evidence.
Published x.20 pin-center spacing has no numeric limit. No arbitrary substitute is claimed.

Full-window acceptance is only for the two named public metal-growth profiles on metals 1-4. Generated masks, complete process-density policy, metal-5 density and all surrounding/boundary contexts remain unqualified.
Floating-fill coupling has not been qualified. Existing routed OpenRCX extraction is retained without a new fill-aware electrical claim.
Strict LVS here is reference qualification evidence; it is not automatically run for every generic macro export.
No new installer, timing/equivalence, complete-chip or foundry-signoff acceptance.
retained_failures: First fill probe used an incomplete stream technology; density inspection rejected zero-width paths.
Second probe omitted explicit FILL maps. Native DRC was clean, but the independent database/GDS comparison and both density profiles reject it.
First application fill inventory worker crashed because OpenROAD Tech lifetime ended too early. Retaining Tech fixes the worker; the fresh application-filled-v2 run passes.
Sandboxed Windows final tests could not create junction fixtures. The same source passes all applicable tests with native filesystem access; both logs are retained.

Initial additional-LVS drivers used an incorrect counter checkpoint path. A later UART fault assumed a diode that the actual design does not contain. Corrected runs use the actual paths and a nonempty flip-flop poly fault for UART; originals remain diagnostic.
The first real wrong-stream control expected the first failure on metal 1; the actual first mismatch was metal 2. The corrected expectation preserves the same observed rejection.
source_phase_note: The first large application/export predates the export single-validation optimization. Small/UART/APB Linux runs use that optimization; final Windows exports and the final 162-test suite use ZIP64 streaming too. Fill generation, checking and final physical artifacts are unchanged by the export-only refinements.
